text_block_list.text:
After finishing our errands, North Flight 
mentioned a place she wanted to stop by, 
which turned out to be a plushie shop.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wah, what a fluffy little bunny! Fufu, the 
little bear next to it is cute too, I 
kinda want to take them both home♪
choice_data_list: I didn't know you liked plushies.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. It's become quite the trend 
recently, thanks to my roommate♪"

I see, they have such big, round eyes. 
Charm is essential for any mascot, after 
all—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, speak of the devil!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Hello, Chan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Flight-san. What a coincidence seeing 
you here.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Studying mascots again today? You're 
really dedicated.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's all to become a mascot loved by 
everyone. Machan will do her very best. 
Mun.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, how have things been 
with Johannes-san since then? He was 
intimidating you before.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Um, if I recall, it was a pigeon... no, a 
crow, I think. It seems Chan-chan has all 
kinds of different friends.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fluffy-fluff... squishy-squish... 
boing-boing... pat-pat...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what an adorable little one! Just 
remember it belongs to the store, so go 
easy on the touching, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, pardon me. Even Mr. Fluffy would hate 
it if you keep bothering him."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“I see. What was it about that girl that 
caught your eye, Chan-chan?”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The feel and the huggability. Just like 
Nago-san by the back gate, it's so squishy 
and fluffy.
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if Nago-san is a friend of hers 
too?)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you must have really taken a liking 
to the brushed fabric and the micro-beads.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case, why don't we go to a craft 
supply store? It might help with our 
mascot research.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what a great idea. Let's get right to 
it, nod-nod.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Rustle rustle... squish squish... slick 
slick... pat pat...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. They may look similar, but the 
difference is like night and day, much 
like Nago-san and Nodogoro-san's coats. 
How profound.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You can make things cute through the 
texture, too. There are plenty of 
varieties, so take a look around!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just from the feel of it... I'm convinced. 
I'll try searching for a new kind of 
'cute' in this shop.
choice_data_list: Since we're here, I'll help look too.
Since we're here, I'll help search too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Wah...! That's a huge help♪

The three of them browsed through the 
fabric section, looking for materials they 
could use to make a mascot.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The brushed fabric has a tumbler finish, 
giving it a gentle, gauze-like texture. 
And the other one is terry cloth? That 
could be interesting!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"They're all so lovely, but I can only 
pick one. If I don't narrow it down to 
one, I feel the memory might lose its 
sharpness."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Just one? Hmm, I can't decide...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: What do you think about it, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
I wonder if it's a brushed material like 
gauze

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's gentle to the touch, and it 
looks like we'll be able to make a simple, 
classic mascot!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mascots make great companions for going 
out, and I think a simpler design looks 
best in all sorts of situations!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"So, Ma-chan, the one Trainer picked 
is... Huh?"
choice_data_list: She's gone! When did she leave!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, here we go again... Chan-me 
really does vanish into thin air like a 
phantom sometimes, doesn't she...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it looks like we'll get a mascot 
that gently wraps around you just by 
looking at it—one that makes you want to 
hug it tight!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You can cuddle it on the sofa or take it 
to bed, it's great for relaxing together!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"So, Ma-chan, the one Trainer picked 
is... Huh?"
choice_data_list: She's gone! When did she leave!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, here we go again... Chan-me 
really does vanish into thin air like a 
phantom sometimes, doesn't she...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"She's a sensible girl, so I'm sure she'll 
be back at the dorm by curfew, but... may 
I go look for her?"

Aston Machan was outside the shop, talking 
to a sparrow at the edge of the street.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you were out before me. Were you able 
to buy the fabric all right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Once I get home, I'll try making a 
mini Chan doll with this.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the finished 
product♪ Show me once it's done, okay?

Even with such an elusive girl, North 
Flight watches over her from a natural, 
comfortable distance. Seeing them so at 
ease together warmed my heart.
